stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro lands in Miami after Brazil election defeat
stories.summary: Defeated Brazilian presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro arrived in Miami on Wednesday, ending days of speculation over his whereabouts after losing Sunday's runoff to Lula. Brazil cancelled his passport as he faces two criminal investigations, which he denies.

stories.title: Browns linked to three players ahead of the trade deadline
stories.summary: With the NFL trade deadline approaching, reports link the 5-2 Browns to three players as they weigh additions for a playoff push. The first-place AFC North club is expected to be a buyer rather than a seller.

stories.title: Apple launches its first touchscreen MacBook Pro
stories.summary: Apple has introduced a new touchscreen MacBook Pro, marking the first time the company's pro laptop line adds a touch display. The move ends years of Apple's resistance to touchscreen Macs.

stories.title: Verstappen, Russell and Norris among F1 drivers to miss Mexico City first practice
stories.summary: Ten Formula 1 regulars, including Max Verstappen, Lando Norris and George Russell, will sit out Friday's first practice in Mexico City as teams fulfil mandatory rookie running. Only Ferrari will field both full-time drivers for the session.

stories.title: Israel faces political deadlock with no clear path to a majority
stories.summary: With 85% of votes counted after Tuesday's election, neither Netanyahu's bloc nor challenger Gadi Eisenkot's has enough seats for a Knesset majority. The likely outcomes now range from a unity government to fresh elections.

stories.title: Google opens Gemini and Search to more third-party apps
stories.summary: Google is expanding which apps Gemini and Search can plug into as AI agents begin reshaping how people use the web. It opens Google's assistant to deeper integration across third-party services.

stories.title: Xreal Aura is a wired headset powered by Android XR
stories.summary: Xreal unveiled the Aura, a new wired headset running Google's Android XR platform. It brings the Android and Gemini ecosystem into a tethered mixed-reality form factor.

stories.title: Insider: Jerry Jeudy's trade value has shifted
stories.summary: An insider says wide receiver Jerry Jeudy's trade value has changed as the deadline nears, with the Browns' strong start complicating any potential deal. Jeudy remains a key piece of Cleveland's passing game.

stories.title: Reddit embraces an algorithmic 'For You' feed
stories.summary: Reddit is rolling out a personalized 'For You' feed, joining other social platforms in pushing algorithmic recommendations over chronological browsing. The change aims to boost engagement and discovery across the platform.

stories.title: UN again condemns US embargo on Cuba, some nations sit out
stories.summary: The UN General Assembly voted overwhelmingly to condemn the decades-old US economic embargo on Cuba, though some members abstained after a Trump administration push. The vote followed a heated on-floor clash between US and Cuban diplomats.

stories.title: Stephen A. Smith draws attention with Deshaun Watson take
stories.summary: Stephen A. Smith weighed in on Deshaun Watson's play after another clutch Browns win, drawing wide reaction. Watson has Cleveland atop the AFC North at 5-2 heading into Week 8.

stories.title: Sergio Perez signs Cadillac extension until at least 2029
stories.summary: Sergio Perez has extended his Cadillac contract through at least 2029, committing his long-term future to the American team ahead of his home race in Mexico City. The deal locks in the veteran's experience as Cadillac builds in its first F1 season.

stories.title: Rookie Quinshon Judkins delivers his best game in Week 7
stories.summary: Rookie running back Quinshon Judkins quietly turned in his best performance of the season in the Browns' 27-24 win over the Titans. His emergence gives Cleveland a productive second option alongside the run game's lead back.

stories.title: Kimi Antonelli set to end Italy's 73-year wait for an F1 champion
stories.summary: Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli is on the verge of clinching the F1 title, needing just two points in Mexico City to become Italy's first champion since Alberto Ascari in 1953. The 20-year-old would also be the sport's youngest-ever champion.

stories.title: Central Ohio cities debate Flock camera usage
stories.summary: Several central Ohio cities are weighing whether to keep or expand Flock license-plate reader cameras amid privacy concerns and mounting community debate. The cameras have drawn both praise for aiding police and criticism over surveillance.

stories.title: Ryan Day not ready to name a starting QB; Fahey and St. Clair could both play
stories.summary: With Julian Sayin injured, Ohio State coach Ryan Day declined to name a starting quarterback for Saturday's game at USC, saying Luke Fahey and Tavien St. Clair could both see time. The decision carries big stakes for the No. 2 Buckeyes' playoff path.

stories.title: One killed in Columbus South Side shooting
stories.summary: Police are investigating a fatal shooting on Columbus' South Side after a person was found dead in an alley. It's the latest in a string of violent incidents the city has been working to address.

stories.title: Day expects a 'full arsenal' on the offensive line vs. USC
stories.summary: Ryan Day said Ohio State should have a healthy offensive line and most injured defenders back for the trip to USC, led by the potential return of Austin Siereveld. A settled front would help whichever young quarterback starts.

stories.title: Day leaves starting QB open as Ohio State preps for USC
stories.summary: Ohio State's Ryan Day kept the starting quarterback decision open during Tuesday's press conference ahead of the Halloween matchup at USC. Fahey and St. Clair both practiced well last week, leaving the competition unsettled.

stories.title: Columbus gas prices dip but stay above $4 a gallon
stories.summary: Gas prices in Columbus have eased recently, though the average remains above $4 per gallon. The relief is welcome for drivers but leaves prices well above where they were earlier this year.
